hero.title: We'd genuinely love to hear from you
hero.description: Whether it's a question about something we've shared, a prayer request, or just a hello this page goes straight to our church, not a committee. Scroll down for the form, or reach out however feels easiest.

form.heading: Write as much or as little as you'd like
form.successNote: Thank you your message is on its way to us. Our team reads everything, so it may take a few days, but we will get back to you.
form.messagePlaceholder: Take your time we'll read all of it.
form.errorDefault: Something went wrong please try again.

items.q: Do you offer priestly counseling to people outside the congregation?
items.a: Yes, within reason. Email us a little about what you're looking for and we'll tell you honestly whether we can help, or point you toward someone better suited.

items.q: Can I request prayer without attending the church?
items.a: Absolutely. Our Wednesday prayer meeting takes requests from anyone, and we pray through the list every morning.

items.q: Are you available for weddings or funerals outside Harbor Light?
items.a: Occasionally, depending on the calendar. Reach out as early as you can these get booked months ahead.

items.q: Do you read and reply to every comment on the blog?
items.a: We try to. It sometimes takes a week or two, but we've never left one unread.

quote.text: You don't need the right words or a good reason. If something's on your heart, we'd rather hear it imperfectly than not at all.
quote.attribution: Debre Selam Abune Gebre Menfes Kidus Church
